service_order_answer_empty: Choose an answer for at least one group.
service_order_answer_hours_billed_requir: Time was clocked on this group. Choose whether the hours are billed.
service_order_answer_job_twice: Each group takes one answer per entry.
service_order_answer_note_too_long: A note has at most 1000 characters.
service_order_cancel_reason_required: Give the reason for the cancellation.
service_order_clock_has_run: Time has already been clocked on this order, so it cannot be cancelled. Decline its groups instead.
service_order_contact_blocked: This contact is blocked ({{reason}}). No workshop order can be opened for them.
service_order_contact_merged: This contact has been merged into another. Choose the contact it was merged into for the order.
service_order_frozen: This order is closed (ready for billing or cancelled) and can no longer be changed.
service_order_job_accepted: This group has been accepted and cannot be deleted. Record the answer instead.
service_order_job_already_answered: The answer for this group has already been recorded.
service_order_job_clocked_confirm: {{names}} is working on this group right now. Change it anyway? If the amount changes, the group waits for the answer again.
service_order_job_stopped: This group was stopped and can no longer be changed. Further work is a new group.
service_order_job_time_clocked: Time has been clocked on this group, so it cannot be deleted. Decline it instead.
service_order_labour_category_unknown: This labour category is not one of this business's.
service_order_labour_rate_missing: No labour rate applies to this category at this location on the order's day. Enter the price.
service_order_position_incomplete: The position is incomplete: labour needs a category, labour by time its time, a fixed price its price, a price whether it is net or with VAT; a text carries no price.
service_order_position_time_clocked: Time has been clocked on this position, so it cannot be deleted.
service_order_price_negative: A price is not below zero.
service_order_price_too_many_decimals: A price has at most four decimals.
service_order_time_not_positive: A labour time is above zero.
service_order_time_too_many_decimals: A labour time has at most two decimals.
service_order_time_unit_changed: Labour time is now entered in another unit here. Check the time and enter it again.
service_order_vat_rate_not_set: No VAT rate is set for this business yet, so no price can be entered.
service_order_vehicle_not_identified: The car is not identified. Choose it among the vehicles or create it first.
service_package_inactive: This package is inactive and is no longer offered.
service_package_labour_category_required: A labour position names its labour category.
service_package_labour_category_unknown: This labour category is not one of this business's.
service_package_labour_rate_missing: No hourly rate applies to a labour category of this package at this location on the order's day, so the package cannot be added.
service_package_labour_time_not_positive: A labour time is above zero.
service_package_labour_time_required: A labour position needs its time.
service_package_labour_time_too_many_dec: A labour time has at most two decimals.
service_package_name_language: A name can only be translated into German, French, Italian or English.
service_package_name_taken: The service catalogue already has a package of this name.
service_package_name_too_long: A package's name has at most 200 characters.
service_package_position_incomplete: A text position has no labour category, no time and no check.
service_package_position_text_required: Every position of the package needs its text.
service_package_position_text_too_long: A position's text has at most 1000 characters.
service_package_time_unit_changed: Labour time is now entered in another unit here. Check the time and enter it again.
service_stay_car_already_here: The car is here already and cannot be received a second time.
service_stay_mileage_invalid: A mileage is a whole number from 0.
service_stay_text_too_long: The text is too long (at most {{maxLength}} characters).
